steps.text: Beli klepon hangat dari Pedagang Antik di Pasar Lama.
steps.text_en: Buy warm klepon from the Antique Vendor at the Old Market.

steps.text: Serahkan klepon kepada Bu RT Sumi di depan rumah nenek.
steps.text_en: Give the klepon to Bu RT Sumi outside grandma's house.

steps.text: Terima lampu minyak dari Penjaga Stasiun.
steps.text_en: Take the oil lamp from the Station Keeper.

steps.text: Gantung dan nyalakan lampu di Kait Lampu Loket.
steps.text_en: Hang and light the lamp on the booth hook.

steps.text: Dengarkan cerita Juru Kunci di Makam Bukit.
steps.text_en: Hear the Keeper's story at the Hill Cemetery.

steps.text: Petik kamboja dan letakkan di nisan Nenek.
steps.text_en: Pick a frangipani and lay it on Grandma's grave.

steps.text: Abadikan semua Sudut Pandang (penanda emas) di tiap lokasi.
steps.text_en: Capture every Viewpoint (gold marker) in each location.
